select (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, sum(tab.FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(tab.ValueSaleReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, sum(tab.FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,case when sum(AdvanceAmount) > 0 then 3 else 1 end as Adjusted from ( Select distinct SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, CustomerParty.CustomerName as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) - (isnull(TUnitPrice,0) * SalesTaxPercent / (100 + SalesTaxPercent)) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced)
else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) {0} )tab
group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage,InvoiceDetailID
union all
select
PaymentID as InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName,'' as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
-- Order By CustomerCategory,InvoiceNumber

--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 1 -- Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-05-28 00:00:00:000'
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 3 --Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-06-03 00:00:00:000'
Select FinalTAB.CompanyName,RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) as CustomerName,Count(distinct FinalTAB.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber,SUM(FinalTAB.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,SUM(FinalTAB.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance ,SUM(FinalTAB.WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount --,FinalTAB.DocumentType ,FinalTAB.Inclusive ,avg(FinalTAB.AvgRate) as AvgRate from ( Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName , SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1 --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2 --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3 , SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber
-- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice -- ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount -- , SET_Currency.CurrencySign -- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount -- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount --, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
--,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) -- when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Ethanol%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 )) -- when set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' -- then -- ( -- case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then -- CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
-- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- )

-- ) )) )

,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced)
else (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable
-- ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, --SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount --,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.unitprice as AvgRate From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
Union All
Select -- '' As BilledtoName, '' AS BilledtoAddress, '' As BilledtoZipCode, '' AS BilledtoPhone, --'' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName,
-- SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, -- SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, -- SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, --SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, -- SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber -- 0 AS DispatchNo, -- 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,
-- FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, -- '' as InvoicedDescription, -- AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, -- AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, --'' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName,
-- , Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, -- 0 as UnitPrice, -- 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, -- 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, -- ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') -- as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount -- ,'0' as CustomerRefNo -- , 0 as WithHolding, -- 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount -- , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount -- ,0 as BrokerID, --'' as DealerName, --'' as SaleOrderDate , case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then 0 --(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantity * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) else Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount end as AmountReceivable
-- Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount --,'0' as DTRENo, --SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount --,0 ,0 as FurtherTaxAdvance
,Convert(int,0)Inclusive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0 as AvgRate from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
)FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTAB.CompanyName,RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) ,FinalTAB.Inclusive Order bY RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) asc

data.name: Query_SaleRegItemwise
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FiscalID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-05-29 00:00:00:000'
select 'BAGASSE' as ItemName, 'BAGASSE' as ItemSubDetail ,isnull(SUM(Baggas.Quantity),0) as Quantity, isnull(SUM(Baggas.AmountReceivable),0) as AmountReceivable , isnull(SUM(Baggas.WithHoldingAmount),0) as WithHoldingAmount ,isnull(SUM(Baggas.SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount , isnull(SUM(Baggas.FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount ,isnull(SUM(Baggas.ValueSaleReturn),0) as ValueSaleReturn ,0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as AdvanceAmount , 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance from ( Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Bagasse%' then '2303 - Residues of starch manufacture, similar residues beet-pulp, bagasse and other waste of sugar manufacture, brewing or distilling dregs and waste, whether or not in the form of pellets' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
-- , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount ,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc ) = 1 then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )

Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @FiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' Union All
Select Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount , case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then 0 else Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount end as AmountReceivable ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0 as FurtherTaxAdvance from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @FiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' )FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and FinalTAB.CustomerID not in (select customerID from AR_Set_Customer where IsRegistered = 1) and FinalTAB.InvoiceHeaderID in (select InvoiceID from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where AdvanceAmount > 0 and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and CurrentFiscalID = @FiscalID and status = 1)

-- end --) --else --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice --from SET_SalesTaxParameters --where Status = 1 --and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID --and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate --order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
-- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) -- end -- END
-- else 0 end -- AS SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc ) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
--,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable,
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity --)
else (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable,
--,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable,
--,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 --then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive --else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) -- end as AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo, SAL_ContractHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,Convert(decimal(18,4),SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail) as FreightDetail , isnull((select InvoiceID from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID in @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1 group by InvoiceID having SUM(AdvanceAmount) > 0),0) LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) -- And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
Union All

data.value:
Select * from ( Select ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, --AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, 0) = 1 THEN SET_City.CityName ELSE [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyAddress END ) AS CustomerAddress ,
AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * isnull(inv_item.UnitWeight,0) / isnull(inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1) as MtonQty, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG as PricePerKG, case when SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail is not null then SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end as PricePerKG, inv_item.UnitWeight, inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
--,case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then --CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
-- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- )
-- THEN
-- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
-- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
-- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
-- --+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- -- ) THEN 3.60
-- -- ELSE 0
-- -- END ) -- ) )) )
-- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
-- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
-- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
-- --+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- -- ) THEN 3.60
-- -- ELSE 0
-- -- END ) -- ) ) )
-- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
-- / ( 100
-- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
-- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
-- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
-- ELSE
-- (( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
-- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
-- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
-- END -- else 0 end -- AS SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc ) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 )* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
--, ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * CASE WHEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, -- 0)) > 0 -- THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, -- 0)) -- ELSE ( ( CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL -- THEN SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG -- ELSE SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG -- END ) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) -- END )) )- [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding as AmountReceivable,
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity --)
else (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable, ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) - (isnull(TUnitPrice,0) * SalesTaxPercent / (100 + SalesTaxPercent)) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as SALInvoiceNumber From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
