,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,SET_City.CityName ,SET_Area.AreaName ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName,TaxonGovtLevis,GovtLevisAmount,FurtherTaxonGovtLevis FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].Status = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_Customer.FK_BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_City ON SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID LEFT JOIN SET_Area ON SET_Area.AreaID = AR_SET_Customer.AreaID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
--,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.3404 end -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- and ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0) = '0' -- ) -- THEN -- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE -- ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) -- END -- as SaleTaxAmount
,CASE WHEN ( SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate > '2019-07-01' AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.3404 end AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' ) THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) )) ) - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) ) ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 )
END as SaleTaxAmount
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer --,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo , SAL_ContractHeader.DTREDate --,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG) As AmountReceivable ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,
--[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII as CustomerName case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else CustomerParty.CustomerName end as CustomerName
--,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress ,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end as CustomerAddress,
case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber else CustomerParty.NTNNumber end as CustomerNTN, case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber else CustomerParty.PhoneNumber end as CustomerPhoneNumber , case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber else CustomerParty.STRNNumber end as CustomeSTRN
--,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII as CNICNumber,
,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber else [SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverCNIC end as CNICNumber,
[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber
,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate, ( case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate,0) ) end
) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select top 1 SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount
,ISNULL((Select top 1 AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment inner join AP_AdvanceSugarPayment on AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.AdvancePaymentID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0) APRNo
,ISNULL((Select top 1 AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment inner join AP_AdvanceSugarPayment on AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.AdvancePaymentID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0) APRDate
, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select top 1 SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select top 1 SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo , case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) else upper(substring(customerparty.CustomerName,0,5)) end as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else customerparty.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,SET_City.CityName ,SET_Area.AreaName ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_Customer.FK_BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_City ON SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID LEFT JOIN SET_Area ON SET_Area.AreaID = AR_SET_Customer.AreaID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[DiscountAmount],0) + ( (((Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) - ISNULL((Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail .InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail .CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID]),0) ) * (ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost],0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) -(ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[DiscountAmount],0))) * ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SalesTax],0) / 100) )) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) * (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) end )end as NetAmount,
-- Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then abs(ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0)) -- else INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount end as TotalAmount, -- convert(bit,ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].IsSalesTaxExempted, 0)) IsSalesTaxExempted, -- Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].SalesTaxAmount, 0) Else ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax, 0) -- End As SalesTaxAmount, -- ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount, 0) as DiscountAmountTaken, --ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].IsExciseDutyExempted, 0) IsExciseDutyExempted, -- convert(bit, ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].Inclusive, 0)) Inclusive, --[SAL_ContractDetail].ExciseDutyAmount, --Convert(bit,ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].IsFEDExempted, 0)) IsFEDExempted, -- [SAL_ContractDetail].FEDAmount , '' [Action], SAL_DispatchHeader.OtherDiscount, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType -- ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BilledToID --,ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].T_Rate,0) as T_Rate, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then abs(ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0)) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount end as TotalAmount, convert(bit,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsSalesTaxExempted, 0)) IsSalesTaxExempted, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) Else ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax, 0) End As TaxAmount, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount, 0) as DiscountAmountTaken, ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsExciseDutyExempted, 0) IsExciseDutyExempted, convert(bit, ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0)) Inclusive, SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, Convert(bit,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsFEDExempted, 0)) IsFEDExempted, SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount , '' [Action], SAL_DispatchHeader.OtherDiscount, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BilledToID ,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) as T_Rate, SaleContractDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG,ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0)FreightDetail ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo, 0.00 as GovtLevisAmount, 0.00 as TaxonGovtLevis, 0.00 as FurtherTaxonGovtLevis, isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FCRate,0.00) as FCRate, --isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FCAmount,0.00) as FCAmount, ((Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID )) * isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FCRate,0.00)
* (case when isnull(INV_Item.UnitWeight,0) > 1 then 1000 else 1 end) ) as FCAmount, isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.ConversionRate,0) as ConversionRate, 0.00 as LossInTransitQty ,SAL_ContractHeader.CurrencyCode as CurrencyCode ,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.itemid and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.itemid and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.itemid and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_ContractDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]))
end )as SaleTaxAmount ,ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].FEDFixRate,0)as FEDFixRate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
-- LEft JOIN [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID -- AND [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID -- AND [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].Status = 1 --left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID --and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID --and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID --and SAL_ContractHeader.Status =1 --and SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode = 1
LEft JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].Status = 1
LEft JOIN [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractDetailID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractHeaderID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID = [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID= [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].Status = 1
inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_ContractDetail].FiscalID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID and SAL_ContractHeader.Status =1 and SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode = 1
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId= [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID
LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemCategoryID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 ---------- For Order Number ---------- left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID LEft JOIN INV_Item as StockItem ON StockItem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND StockItem.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND StockItem.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category as StockCat ON StockCat.CategoryID = StockItem.ItemTypeID --AND StockCat.CompanyID = StockItem.CompanyID AND StockCat.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure as UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND UOM.Status = 1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status= 1 ) Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 ORDER BY Tab.StockDetailID

SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount) as FEDTaxAmount , ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight
, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_ContractHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_ContractHeader].DTREDate --,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG),0) As AmountReceivable
